body: AI assistance places a metacognitive demand on users, who must judge their own competence and the system's. Yet designers lack comparative evidence on which interventions to choose, where to place them, and how to tell whether they worked. We elicited 30 interventions from 11 experts and, with prior work, organized them into a design space of time (when an intervention acts), level (whose competence is judged), and source (who supplies the monitoring cue). A between-subjects experiment (N = 917; 12 planning-and-organizing problems) compared a per-task reliability card, contrasting replies, pause points, and post-problem reflection against a baseline LLM assistant. Reliability cards and contrasting replies reduced estimation error and overconfidence and increased aggregate confidence discrimination. No task-performance improvement or average within-item discrimination gain was established. We contribute a shared vocabulary, a design space, and evidence that measured monitoring and task performance are separable design targets.
summaryZh: 本文探讨了AI辅助工作中的元认知需求，即用户需评估自身与系统能力的挑战。研究通过专家访谈构建了包含时间、判断层级和信息源的设计空间，并提出了30种干预措施。通过对917名受试者的实验，研究发现可靠性卡片和对比回复能有效降低用户的过度自信并提升信心辨别力，为AI交互设计提供了实证依据。

glossary.explanationZh: 元认知监控，指用户对自身认知过程及AI系统输出可靠性的评估能力。
设计空间，指通过多维度（如时间、层级、来源）对交互干预手段进行系统化分类的框架。
信心辨别力，指用户区分正确与错误回答并相应调整自信程度的能力。
被试间实验，一种实验设计，不同组别的受试者接受不同的干预条件以进行对比。
